chunks: I asked him about a man who fears janabah during travel or in the cold, so he performs salat al-layl and al-witr at the beginning of the night. He said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ: the beginning portion of the night
key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, a circumstance affecting legal rulings
key_terms.الْبَرْدِ: cold weather, a source of hardship
key_terms.الْجَنَابَةَ: the state of major ritual impurity
key_terms.الْوَتْرَ: the witr prayer performed as part of the night prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat al-layl and witr early when one fears janabah during travel or cold weather?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of performing salat al-layl and al-witr at the beginning of the night for one who fears janabah during travel or due to severe cold. It reflects ease in acts of worship when hardship or impediment is anticipated.
